captions.detailed: This object is a vent-only skylight sunroof cassette. It features a large, flat, rectangular black outer frame with rounded corners. Inside the frame, there is a fixed glass panel at one end and a sliding glass vent insert that moves along side-mounted guide rails. The glass surfaces are semi-transparent gray, while the framing and structural guide rails are finished in a solid matte black.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a vent-only skylight sunroof cassette. The assembly must include a main outer frame, a fixed glass panel, side guide rails, and a sliding vent insert that moves prismatically along the rails to open toward the rear.
captions.factory: The script uses CadQuery to construct the sunroof cassette by defining a main frame base with a rounded rectangular cutout. A fixed glass panel is modeled and positioned inside the frame opening. Two parallel guide rails are created along the sides of the frame. The sliding vent insert is constructed as a separate frame containing a glass panel, which is then dynamically linked to the main assembly via a prismatic joint that slides along the longitudinal axis of the guide rails.
